Name: Petleash
Author: Miricancan
Description:
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Description[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the main purpose of your mod[/color][/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🐾 Pet Leash Mod[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Take Your Pets Beyond the Farm![/i][/font][/size]
[line]
[heading][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🇬🇧 English[/i][/font][/size][/heading]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]✨ Features[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🐕 Take your pets into town![/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]This mod adds five different pet leashes, allowing you to bring your furry companions beyond the farm and explore Pelican Town together.[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🎀 More than just a leash[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Besides the basic leash, each additional leash comes with its own unique accessory to give your pet a different look.[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]💬 NPCs will notice your pet[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]When you bring your pet into town, NPCs have a chance to mention your companion during conversations.[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🚶 Natural movement[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Pets can still move freely while on a leash. If they wander too far away, they'll instantly teleport back to your side—so don't worry, the leash will never break.[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🐾 Walk multiple pets together[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Use multiple leashes to take several pets on a walk at the same time.[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🛒 Available at Marnie's Shop[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]All pet leashes can be purchased from Marnie's Shop.[/i][/font][/size]
[line]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]🌐 Language Support[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]If you have the optional Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) installed, you can change the mod language through the configuration menu.[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]This also changes:[/i][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Item descriptions in Marnie's Shop[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]NPC dialogue related to your pets[/i][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Default Language: English[/i][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Currently Supported: English • Simplified Chinese[/i][/font][/size]
[line]
[quote]⚠️ [b]Note:[/b]
Turtle pets are [b]not supported[/b].[/quote][line]
🐾 [b]宠物牵引绳模组[/b]
[i]带着你的宠物，一起逛遍鹈鹕镇！[/i]
[line]
[heading][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🇨🇳 中文[/font][/size][/heading]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]✨ 模组特色[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🐕 [b]带着宠物离开农场！[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]模组新增 [b]5 款不同风格的宠物牵引绳[/b]，让你可以带着心爱的宠物一起前往鹈鹕镇。[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🎀 [b]不仅是牵引绳[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]除了基础款外，其余牵引绳都会为宠物添加不同的专属配饰，让每一只宠物都更有个性。[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]💬 [b]NPC 会注意到你的宠物[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]带着宠物来到镇上与 NPC 交谈时，他们有一定概率会主动提起你的宠物。[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🚶 [b]自由活动，无需担心[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]宠物在牵引状态下依然可以自由行动。当它们离你太远时，会自动瞬移回到你的身边，因此[b]牵引绳永远不会断开[/b]。[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🐾 [b]同时遛多只宠物[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]可以同时装备多根牵引绳，一次带着多只宠物一起散步。[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🛒 [b]购买方式[/b][/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]所有牵引绳均可在 [b]玛妮商店[/b]购买。[/font][/size]
[line]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]🌐 语言支持[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]安装可选前置 [b]Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM）[/b] 后，可以在模组设置中自由切换语言。[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]语言切换同时适用于：[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]玛妮商店中的商品介绍[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]NPC 关于宠物的对话内容[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]默认语言：[/b] 英语[/font][/size]
[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]目前支持：[/b] 英语 • 简体中文[/font][/size]
[line]
[quote]⚠️ [b]注意事项[/b]
[b]本模组暂不支持乌龟宠物。[/b][/quote]
